dataAndBackup.gdprReadme:
GlassFolio — Personal data export archive (GDPR Art. 15 and 20)
Generated on {{date}} in your browser: no data went through a server.

Contents:
- manifest.json: file list, item count per collection, secrets deliberately excluded.
- profile.json: your profile (identifier, email, name, preferences). Password hashes and salts are excluded.
- consent.json: your cookie / audience-measurement consent choice.
- security-summary.json: two-factor status and passkey count (no secrets).
- data/: full JSON backup and one CSV file per data type (spreadsheet-friendly).

Only data actually stored in your account is included; no demo data.
To exercise your other rights (rectification, objection, restriction), see the Privacy Policy.
dataAndBackup.deleteGoogleDriveNote: Your Google account will be asked to confirm, so the key file can be removed from your Google Drive before the account is deleted.

modules.title: Bank modules: where they come from and how they update
modules.intro: Woob reads each bank through a module that follows the bank's website. When a bank changes its site, its module must be updated. Choose where GlassFolio takes them from:
modules.verifiedDesc: GlassFolio tests each new Woob version on its GitHub before shipping it, about once a week. They arrive with GlassFolio's own updates (desktop app update, new Docker image): nothing is downloaded on its own.
modules.latestDesc: Downloaded straight from Woob's official repository (gitlab.com/woob/woob) as soon as Woob fixes a bank, then refreshed automatically every day while GlassFolio runs, or with “Update now”. GlassFolio has not checked them.
modules.verifiedActive: Bank modules verified by GlassFolio (Woob {{commit}}, {{date}}). They are updated every week after GlassFolio checks them.
modules.latestActive: Woob's latest bank modules ({{commit}}, {{date}}), downloaded on {{updated}}. GlassFolio has not checked them.

modules.keptVerified_other: {{count}} banks kept their verified module: their latest version does not work here.
modules.lastError: Last update failed ({{detail}}): the modules in use did not change.
modules.warning: Woob's latest bank modules are downloaded from gitlab.com and run on this computer with your bank credentials, without GlassFolio having checked them. Only use them if a bank does not work with the verified modules.
modules.accept: I understand that code not checked by GlassFolio will handle my bank credentials.

cashHistory.label: Read the operations of my checking and savings accounts (cash flow)
cashHistory.help: The first sync reads up to 12 months, as far back as the bank's website goes. The next ones read the last 45 days again, which the bank may still change. What was read stays in GlassFolio, editable, even once the bank no longer shows it.
